clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 马斯克成全球首位万亿富豪 财富可买下美欧日所有车企 还够资助火星殖民
title_lines: 马斯克成全球首位万亿富豪
财富可买下美欧日所有车企

subtitles.en: Elon Musk is officially the world's first trillionaire, possessing a fortune so massive it practically defies imagination.
subtitles.zh: 埃隆·马斯克正式成为全球首位万亿富翁，其财富规模之大，几乎超乎想象。

subtitles.en: How rich is a trillionaire? A billion dollars lets you spend $27,000 a day for a century. A trillion dollars?
subtitles.zh: 万亿富翁有多富？十亿美元能让你每天花2.7万美元，持续一个世纪。一万亿美元呢？

subtitles.en: That is the equivalent to spending $27 million every single day for a hundred years. To put that into perspective, Bloomberg News did the math on what Musk could theoretically do
subtitles.zh: 相当于每天花2700万美元，持续一百年。彭博新闻社计算了马斯克用一万亿美元理论上能做什么。

subtitles.en: with a $1 trillion fortune. First, he could buy back PayPal, the company that launched his career, and he could do that
subtitles.zh: 首先，他可以回购PayPal——这家公司开启了他的职业生涯，而且他能回购超过25次。

subtitles.en: more than 25 times over. Even wilder, a trillion dollars is enough to buy out every single automotive competitor in US,
subtitles.zh: 更疯狂的是，一万亿美元足以买下美国、欧洲和日本的所有汽车竞争对手，而且还有剩余。
en_highlights: buy out every single automotive competitor

subtitles.en: Europe, and Japan can buy, and still have cash left over.
subtitles.zh: 马斯克的财富也转化为前所未有的政治和全球影响力。

subtitles.en: Musk's wealth also translates to unprecedented political and global power.
subtitles.zh: 一万亿美元足以让68个联邦选举周期破产，按2024年的支出水平计算。

subtitles.en: $1 trillion could bankrupt 68 federal election cycles at 2024 spending levels.
subtitles.zh: 这也足以资助NASA全年预算41次。事实上，如果马斯克是一个国家，

subtitles.en: It's also enough to fund NASA's entire annual budget 41 times over. In fact, if Musk were a country,
subtitles.zh: 他的个人净资产将使他比156个国家更富有，包括卡塔尔、芬兰和肯尼亚。

subtitles.en: his net personal wealth would make him richer than 156 nations, including Qatar, Finland, and Kenya.
subtitles.zh: 他的个人净资产比156个国家的财富还多，包括卡塔尔、芬兰和肯尼亚。

subtitles.en: We haven't seen this concentrated level of economic leverage since John D. Rockefeller became the first billionaire during the Gilbert Age. But while Rockefeller focused on philanthropy
subtitles.zh: 自约翰·D·洛克菲勒在镀金时代成为首位亿万富翁以来，我们从未见过如此集中的经济杠杆。但洛克菲勒专注于慈善，改变了地球上的生活，而马斯克的目光则投向太阳系。

subtitles.en: that transformed life on Earth, Musk's eyes are on the solar system
subtitles.zh: 自约翰·D·洛克菲勒在镀金时代成为首位亿万富翁以来，我们从未见过如此集中的经济杠杆。但洛克菲勒专注于慈善，改变了地球上的生活，而马斯克的目光则投向太阳系。
